🚨 #BREAKING 

Important Note On #HMPV Virus. 🦠 

#HMPvirus is not a deadly virus.
Most people get HMPV before they turn 5.

While the virus typically causes mild, cold-like symptoms, it can lead to severe illness in young children, the elderly, or those with weakened immunity.
